pins.title: Keep your socks dry
pins.sub: Leg gaiters strap over your boots and keep mud, wet leaves, snow and pebbles out.

pins.title: Tell someone your plan
pins.sub: Text a friend your trail, trailhead, car and the time to call for help if you're not back.

pins.title: Pack these 5
pins.sub: Add any personal medicines you need, and restock it after every trip.

pins.title: Smokies in November
pins.sub: Check road status on nps.gov/grsm before you drive in.

pins.title: Warm, not sweaty
pins.sub: Windproof fleece over a wicking base layer, quick-dry pants, merino socks. Unzip on the climb.
